lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in near-vertical columns of 3 to 4 units, located posterior to the branchial region. Horizontal spacing between columns is approximately 1.5 times the vertical spacing between individual blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of spots, creating a rectangular grid-like appearance where the spots serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge to a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark, irregular vertical line or jagged mark is visible immediately posterior to the final gill slit, suggesting a healed laceration or deep tissue indentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, labyrinthine patterns are visible on the dorsal cranial region, transitioning into discrete spots posteriorly. Several small teleost fish are visible in the sub-ventral field of view.
